dependencies.basis: BPS National Labour Force Survey (Sakernas) employment concepts and classifications follow ILO / ICLS guidelines (13th, 19th and later resolutions).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The BPS follows the international guidelines set out by the ILO for measuring employment. ... Implementation of the ICLS Concept in Sakernas 1986-2015 Employment data collection based on the 13th International Conference of Labour Statisticians (ICLS) Concept as the primary framework for classifying employment status. 2016-February 2020 The 19th ICLS Concept was introduced to support the identification of informal workers

dependencies.basis: Sakernas industry classifications refer to ISIC (with occupation classifications referring to ISCO).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Classifications: The classifications of industry and occupation referred to ISIC and ISCO, except for the occupation classification of SAKERNAS 2000 referred to ASCO.

dependencies.basis: Informal employment proportion statistics are derived from Sakernas labour-force survey data (including expanded modules for informal identification).
dependencies.evidence_quote: For the time being, statistics on the informal economy in Indonesia are based on the regular national labour force survey (Sakernas) which only lies on the employment status and occupation ... dependencies.basis: National accounts coverage of informal activities and labour inputs draws on the Labour Force Survey (Sakernas / LFS) as a supplementary source for informal production and employment.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Labor Force Survey (LFS) could be used to measure informal activities. ... The LFS could also be used to identify informal activities. This could be more reliable as it is run each year, rather than every 10 years like the census.

dependencies.basis: Labour productivity and related indicators rely on employment and hours data from the National Labour Force Survey (Sakernas).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Statistics for employment are obtained from the National Labour Force Survey (SAKERNAS) conducted by the Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS)-Statistics Indonesia.
